title: rosa viscaria var. setocarpa
intro: Rosa viscaria var. setocarpa, commonly known as Alpine Sweet Briar, is a flowering plant species belonging to the rose family (Rosaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including inflammation, pain, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits in reducing fever and soothing digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Rosa viscaria var. setocarpa include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which help to alleviate symptoms and promote healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
